title: Is this why the backrooms creepypasta is so popular?
content: I feel like that is a major component as to why the backrooms became so popular. I think most of the people have seen similar “liminal spaces” in their dreams, and even if they don’t remember them, it subconsciously reminds them of their dreams. The weird feelings people get when looking at liminal spaces are because they are remembering dreams they forgot maybe? Idk but i definitely feel like the backrooms are inspired by mall world type dreams
